offering_description.value: Manages diagnostic imaging centers (primarily MRI) through its HMCA subsidiary, providing non-medical management services to physician-owned practices, mainly in Florida and New York. Also designs and manufactures MRI scanners, sold to healthcare providers and used in its own managed centers.

primary_products.value: magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanners; MRI service and upgrade parts

primary_services.value: diagnostic imaging center management; MRI scanner servicing and maintenance; billing and administrative services for physician practices

customer_segment.value: B2B: physician-owned diagnostic imaging practices, hospitals and healthcare providers buying MRI scanners and management services; B2C: patients receiving scans, typically billed through insurers

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees from physician-owned imaging practices, based on practice revenue; product sales: MRI scanner sales; service fees: scanner maintenance and repair contracts
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: manages imaging centers, handling administration, billing and staffing for physician practices; OEM / manufacturer: builds MRI scanners from purchased components, sold to healthcare providers

geography_served.value: US regional: Management centers mainly in Florida and New York, scanner servicing across the US

specialization.value: related lines: imaging center management plus MRI scanner manufacturing and servicing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: managed diagnostic imaging centers serving patients and referring physicians; direct sales: MRI scanners and service contracts sold directly to healthcare providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: MRI devices need FDA clearance, healthcare services subject to Medicare/insurer billing rules, HIPAA and state medical practice laws
